# CC0 Quaternius house-interior assets — V0.13

15 `.glb` models from [trebeljahr/quaternius-showcase](https://github.com/trebeljahr/quaternius-showcase/tree/0128ca510d653bb04d6d1e4885bd8890b5050b4f/public/glb/house_interior_pack), commit `0128ca510d653bb04d6d1e4885bd8890b5050b4f`.

**Creator:** Quaternius. **Original pack:** [Ultimate House Interior Pack (June 2020)](https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatehomeinterior.html), listed as **CC0** by the pack owner. Showcase code's MIT license is separate; the models are CC0, not MIT. Redistributed GLBs are not generated by OpenAI. Assets remain unchanged from the source; `tests/check_art_v13.py` checks each original Git blob SHA-1, refusing silently modified models.

Art selected: `Chair_2`, `Chair_3`, `Couch_Medium2`, `Couch_Small2`, `Table_RoundSmall2`, `Table_RoundLarge`, `Stool`, `Light_Ceiling1`, `Light_Floor2`, `Houseplant_4`, `Bookshelf`, `Curtains_Double`, `Shelf_Large`, `Kitchen_Sink`, `Plate_1`.

Original texture maps in `art/interiors_v13` are generated locally by `tools/build_art_v13.py` under CC0. Not photogrammetry or licensed photos.

Do not assume these models meet final realism expectations merely because their license and geometry have been verified.
